title: citrus japonica subf. crassifolia
intro: Citrus japonica subf. crassifolia, commonly known as the Sudachi, is a species of small citrus fruit-bearing tree or shrub native to Japan. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of nausea and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Sudachi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sudachi, particularly limonoids and flavonoids, have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
